card.name: Last digit of a number before units
card.fires_on: The final digit of a number just before a unit or 'years', such as the 0 in age > 60 or the 5 in age ≥65. It also fires on the last digit of a paper size before 'inches'.

modes.label: Age cutoff digit
modes.description: Last digit of an age threshold such as 60 or 65, right before 'years'.

modes.label: Paper size digit
modes.description: Last digit of a measurement just before the unit 'inches'.

card.writes: It pushes the model to write a unit of measure next, such as dollars, pounds, inches or grams.
card.plain: It marks the end of a number where a unit word like years or inches should come next.
